canonical_statement: For every field k, every positive natural number n, and every finitely generated projective module P over k[X1,...,Xn], P is free.

source_root.selection: field specialization of Suslin's Theorem 3* PID freeness clause on page 1066, aligned with the field question and affirmative answer on page 1063
source_root.citation: A. A. Suslin, Projective modules over a polynomial ring are free, Doklady Akademii Nauk SSSR 229(5), 1063-1066 (1976), journal pages 1063 and 1066
source_root.review_boundary: The primary Russian scan was inspected but independent translation, errata review, Quillen full-text reconciliation, and master source acceptance remain open, so source status remains H1 rather than H0.

canonical_formal_target.fully_explicit_expression:
∀ (k : Type u) [inst : Field.{u} k] (n : Nat),
  @LT.lt.{0} Nat instLTNat (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Nat (nat_lit 0) (instOfNatNat (nat_lit 0))) n →
    ∀ (P : Type v) [inst_1 : AddCommGroup.{v} P]
      [inst_2 :
        @Module.{u, v}
          (@MvPolynomial.{0, u} (Fin n) k (@Semifield.toCommSemiring.{u} k (@Field.toSemifield.{u} k inst))) P
          (@AddMonoidAlgebra.semiring.{u, 0} k
            (@Finsupp.{0, 0} (Fin n) Nat (@MulZeroClass.toZero.{0} Nat Nat.instMulZeroClass))
            (@CommSemiring.toSemiring.{u} k (@Semifield.toCommSemiring.{u} k (@Field.toSemifield.{u} k inst)))
            (@Finsupp.instAddMonoid.{0, 0} (Fin n) Nat Nat.instAddMonoid))
          (@AddCommGroup.toAddCommMonoid.{v} P inst_1)]
      [@Module.Finite.{u, v}
          (@MvPolynomial.{0, u} (Fin n) k (@Semifield.toCommSemiring.{u} k (@Field.toSemifield.{u} k inst))) P
          (@AddMonoidAlgebra.semiring.{u, 0} k
            (@Finsupp.{0, 0} (Fin n) Nat (@MulZeroClass.toZero.{0} Nat Nat.instMulZeroClass))
            (@CommSemiring.toSemiring.{u} k (@Semifield.toCommSemiring.{u} k (@Field.toSemifield.{u} k inst)))
            (@Finsupp.instAddMonoid.{0, 0} (Fin n) Nat Nat.instAddMonoid))
          (@AddCommGroup.toAddCommMonoid.{v} P inst_1) inst_2]
      [@Module.Projective.{u, v}
          (@MvPolynomial.{0, u} (Fin n) k (@Semifield.toCommSemiring.{u} k (@Field.toSemifield.{u} k inst)))
          (@AddMonoidAlgebra.semiring.{u, 0} k
            (@Finsupp.{0, 0} (Fin n) Nat (@MulZeroClass.toZero.{0} Nat Nat.instMulZeroClass))
            (@CommSemiring.toSemiring.{u} k (@Semifield.toCommSemiring.{u} k (@Field.toSemifield.{u} k inst)))
            (@Finsupp.instAddMonoid.{0, 0} (Fin n) Nat Nat.instAddMonoid))
          P (@AddCommGroup.toAddCommMonoid.{v} P inst_1) inst_2],
      @Module.Free.{u, v}
        (@MvPolynomial.{0, u} (Fin n) k (@Semifield.toCommSemiring.{u} k (@Field.toSemifield.{u} k inst))) P
        (@AddMonoidAlgebra.semiring.{u, 0} k
          (@Finsupp.{0, 0} (Fin n) Nat (@MulZeroClass.toZero.{0} Nat Nat.instMulZeroClass))
          (@CommSemiring.toSemiring.{u} k (@Semifield.toCommSemiring.{u} k (@Field.toSemifield.{u} k inst)))
          (@Finsupp.instAddMonoid.{0, 0} (Fin n) Nat Nat.instAddMonoid))
        (@AddCommGroup.toAddCommMonoid.{v} P inst_1) inst_2

domain_and_universes: k is an explicit Type u with a Field instance; n is an explicit natural number with an explicit 0 < n premise; P is an explicit Type v with AddCommGroup and module structures over MvPolynomial (Fin n) k. The coefficient and module universes are independent.
hypotheses: n is positive, matching the source notation X1,...,Xn rather than adding an unspoken zero-variable extension
P is a unital left module over the commutative polynomial ring MvPolynomial (Fin n) k
P is finitely generated as a module
P is projective as a module
conclusion: Module.Free (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k) P: P admits a basis over the same polynomial ring.
minimal_import_basis: Projective supplies Module.Projective and Free; Algebra.MvPolynomial.Basic supplies the multivariable polynomial carrier and ring/module structure; Finiteness.Defs supplies Module.Finite. Deleting any direct import fails. The broader RingTheory.MvPolynomial.Basic and aggregate Mathlib imports are deliberately absent.
